description: Waterways Conservation Act Management Areas (DWER-072) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Water and Environmental Regulation. This dataset identifies the Management Areas declared under the Waterways Conservation Act 1976. Under the Waterways Conservation Act 1976, the Minister for Water and the Department of Water and Environmental Regulation have responsibility for the conservation of the waters and associated land in five declared Management Areas. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Water and Environmental Regulation. Its tags are Boundaries Administrative. It offers 8 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage, shp. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Active Acceptance). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
